description: TIA传输影响评估—SCC传输工具，EU→US，政府访问风险+端到端加密补充措施

input.data_exporter_profile: EU Exporter GmbH — 欧盟制造业企业，客户关系管理数据
input.data_importer_profile: US Importer Inc. — 美国CRM服务商，受FISA 702管辖
input.third_country_assessment: 美国存在政府机构大规模访问风险(Schrems II)，FISA 702条款允许情报机构获取数据
input.supplementary_measures: 端到端加密(AES-256)、严格密钥管理(HSM)、访问透明报告、数据本地化备份
input.final_conclusion: 在补充措施(端到端加密+HSM密钥管理)有效实施的前提下，SCC可作为合法传输工具

coverage_note: This case exercises the UNSTRUCTURED path only. tia/service.py branches on payload.structured_input: when absent it computes risk_level via _resolve_risk_level(third_country_assessment, final_conclusion), a keyword scan (HIGH on 高/high/不可/cannot/not effective, MEDIUM on 中/medium/条件/conditional, else LOW). This input contains none of those tokens, so LOW is the correct computed result — not a fallback. country_risk, route_decision and measure_assessments are null/empty because TIACountryRiskAssessor, TIARouteDecider and TIAMeasureSufficiency only run inside the structured_input branch; the assertions above pin that contract. GAP: no CLI case supplies structured_input, so the structured decision engine (country risk, data sensitivity, measure sufficiency, route decision) has zero harness coverage. A 02_structured case is needed to reach it.
